title: Compact supports on the ordinary etale category
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative coefficient ring. Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] (schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings), and fix a compactification $c=(j,r)$, meaning a factorization $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{r}S$ with $j$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $r$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $rj=f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

Let $j_!$ on sheaves be etale extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Write $Q_T$ for localization of complexes, or of their homotopy category, at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The degreewise application of $j_!$ to complexes preserves quasi-isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact]; denote by $Dj_!$ its descent along the localization functors $Q_T$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property], normalized by $Dj_!Q_X\cong Q_{\overline X}j_!$.

Let $r_*$ be the module-sheaf direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Degreewise application of this additive functor respects the chain-homotopy equation $h-h' = ds+sd$, shifts, and the cone differential $\left(\begin{smallmatrix}d_L&h\\0&-d_K\end{smallmatrix}\right)$, because it respects sums and negatives. Hence $Q_Sr_*$ on the homotopy category is exact for the cone triangulations [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-triangulated-category]. On the unbounded categories define $Rr_*$ as the total right derived functor of $Q_Sr_*$ on the homotopy category, using [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived] and the K-injective resolutions of [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions], [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Thus for a representing complex $L$ and a K-injective resolution $L\to I$, $Rr_*(Q_{\overline X}L)\cong Q_S(r_*I)$. A morphism between resolved objects is sent to $Q_S(r_*h)$, where $h$ is its representing homotopy class of maps between the K-injective resolutions [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]. This is the unbounded total derived construction, rather than only the bounded-below functor recorded in [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

Define the ordinary etale compact-support candidate by
$$Rf_!^c:=Rr_*\circ Dj_!:D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)\longrightarrow D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A).$$
This is the ordinary etale module-coefficient instance of the chosen-compactification construction [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]; the preceding paragraphs specify its unbounded interpretation.

On a complex $K$, first form $j_!K$ degreewise, then take a K-injective resolution $j_!K\to I$ on $\overline X$, and return $Q_S(r_*I)$. On morphisms use the composite of the two functors just specified. In the conventional formula $Rr_*j_!$, $j_!$ denotes this induced derived functor.

The proper-refinement comparison normalized to be the identity over $X$, its coherence and invertibility, and compactification-independent notation $Rf_!$ are the properties to be supplied by the separate node lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons (a pointer, not an ingredient defining the candidate). This definition makes no identification with a functor on a pro-etale coefficient category. No boundedness or constructibility condition is imposed on the input complex.

    DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology A)
lean.note: Use rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) c for Λ : Type (u + 1), [CommRing Λ], {X S : Scheme.{u}}, {f : X ⟶ S}, c : Compactification f. The coefficient parameter A in the recorded source signature is a Grothendieck abelian category, specialized here to ModuleCat Λ. Its body is exactly D((c.i)_!open[ModuleCat Λ]) ⋙ R((c.g)_*[ModuleCat Λ]), on unbounded derived categories. This declaration exists in the local slopmaster2 source as well as the master record of def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification; no duplicate module is needed. Restricting its scheme arguments to Noetherian schemes gives precisely this node. The additional K-injective paragraphs describe its existing totalRightDerived construction, not further defining data. Server specialization probe compiled cleanly.

blueprint_update.statement:
For a compactification
$c=(j,r)$ of $f:X\to S$ between Noetherian schemes,
define the ordinary etale compact-support candidate by

$$
Rf_!^c=Rr_*j_!:D(X_{\rm et},A)\longrightarrow D(S_{\rm et},A).
$$

Here $j_!$ is the etale
extension by zero,
and $Rr_*$ is the ordinary
derived direct image.
For a proper refinement take the comparison which is the
identity over $X$; the resulting functor is denoted $Rf_!$.
